title: Rav Dimi bar Nechemyah son of Rav Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman mentions him in [Sanhedrin 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.24a.21) according to the readings of Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin; his “our version” reads Rav Dimi son of Rav Nachman.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sanhedrin passages at [23b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.23b.1) and 24a give Rav Dimi son of Rav Nachman son of Rav Yosef. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=919&lang=en) gives the same reading and discusses Nechemyah as a possible reading of Yuchasin. Hyman reports Nechemyah from Dikdukei Soferim and Yuchasin.
